title: refactor(configure): migrate to TypeScript
body:
## Description

This refactors `connectConfigure` and `configure` to TypeScript.

The changes are mainly type definitions which are as long as the source so Git thinks they're whole new files.

I added some basic tests for the `configure` widget.

## Result

- I removed the widget scope pollution by moving `this._refine` to a variable.
- The connector/widget are now typed
